value.message: This paper (PMID:42437345) self-reports multiple experimental systems: minigene splicing assay (functionally_abnormal); transcriptional isoform profiling (long-read RNA-seq) (functionally_abnormal); protein abundance (Western blot) (functionally_abnormal); contractility and calcium imaging (functionally_abnormal). It is recommended to go back to the relevant part of the full text and manually confirm which of these is genuinely the most direct functional evidence for the overall direction below (there is a past instance of an indirect results table being cited by mistake).

This judgment (PMID:42437345) is based on a single study only. For criterion codes on the ClinGen side that require reproducibility across multiple studies (e.g., PS3_Moderate or stronger), this evidence alone may not be sufficient in strength.

In this paper (PMID:42437345), none of the extracted experiments' key_findings contain any numeric detail, yet the LLM confidently concluded PS3. This suggests the extraction may describe the paper's general methodology rather than a measurement specifically reported for the target variant, so the judgment has been forced to not_clear (real-world instance: TP53 c.875A>G, where the paper is a large-scale saturation screen and the target variant's specific score was only in supplementary data).

value.label: minigene splicing assay: functionally_abnormal
value.detail: HEK293T and iPSC-CMs, readout: proportion of canonical vs noncanonical splice isoforms, vs wild type (reference minigene) - P/LP variants, including those at canonical splice sites, exhibited a markedly lower proportion of canonically spliced isoforms.

value.label: transcriptional isoform profiling (long-read RNA-seq): functionally_abnormal
value.detail: iPSC-CMs (isogenic lines generated via prime editing), readout: canonical isoform fraction and cryptic splicing events, vs WT (wild type) iPSC-CMs - Genotype-dependent reduction of the canonical isoform and detection of a cryptic splicing event (A3'SS+91).

value.label: protein abundance (Western blot): functionally_abnormal
value.detail: iPSC-CMs (isogenic lines generated via prime editing), readout: cMyBP-C protein levels, vs WT and heterozygous iPSC-CMs - Homozygous variant lines exhibited significant reduction in cMyBP-C protein abundance.

value.label: contractility and calcium imaging: functionally_abnormal
value.detail: iPSC-CMs (isogenic lines generated via prime editing), readout: contractile amplitude and calcium amplitude, vs WT iPSC-CMs - Heterozygous cells showed increased contractile and Ca2+ amplitudes; homozygous cells showed reduced amplitudes.
